title: Unit – 4 : Session – 5 | Deluded Self, Pure Self and Holistic Development
sections: Q1. DELUDED SELF vs PURE SELF — BASIS OF IMAGINATION: the Deluded Self imagines on the basis of PRECONDITIONING and SENSATION (assumptions absorbed from society, bodily tastes); the Pure Self imagines on the basis of KNOWING/NATURAL ACCEPTANCE (verified understanding of co-existence). ACTIVE LEVEL: the Deluded Self operates at the level of assuming-without-knowing — hence desires, thoughts and expectations are indefinite and contradictory; the Pure Self operates at the level of knowing — hence imagination is definite and in harmony. OUTCOME: the Deluded Self produces excitement followed by emptiness, exploitation and conflict; the Pure Self produces continuous happiness, definite conduct and mutual fulfilment. Transformation (holistic development) is the journey from the first to the second.

Q2. WHY physical facility alone CANNOT transform a human being: transformation is a change at the level of the SELF's activity — from assuming-without-knowing to knowing — and physical facility addresses only the BODY. No quantity of money, comfort or technology can produce understanding or right feeling; evidence: wealthy, comfortable people are often anxious, isolated and exploitative. HOLISTIC DEVELOPMENT requires all THREE components: (1) RIGHT UNDERSTANDING in the Self (through value education/self-exploration), (2) RIGHT FEELING/RELATIONSHIP with human beings (trust, respect... in family and society), (3) PHYSICAL FACILITY for the body — produced and used with right understanding. Only the three together constitute development of the human being as co-existence of Self and Body.

Q3. REALISATION OF CO-EXISTENCE → UNIVERSAL HUMAN ORDER: when the Self realises (sees directly, not merely believes) that existence is co-existence — units submerged in space in harmony — its assuming becomes anchored in knowing. From such realised individuals come: definite human conduct, families of trust and prosperity, a society of fearlessness, and systems (education, production, justice, exchange) designed for mutual fulfilment — which together constitute the Universal Human Order. The order is thus not legislated from outside; it is the natural expression of realised human beings at every level from family to world family.

Q4. A RECENT DECISION analysed: choosing between buying an expensive gadget on impulse versus continuing with my working phone. B2 (sensation/preconditioning) said: 'everyone has the new model; it will feel good' — the pull was real and strong. B1 (realisation/right understanding) asked: 'is this a real need of the body? will it serve my relationship or understanding?' — the honest answer was no. I acted on B1, kept the phone, and felt settled rather than deprived — the satisfaction lasted, unlike the brief excitement of past impulse buys. This small instance showed me that decisions guided by B1 give continuity of happiness while B2 gives only sensation.
